hook.name: CornersHookStaticFee
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Corners protocol that applies configurable static directional LP fees (cornersFee vs. pairedFee) per pool via updateDynamicLPFee, collects a 20% protocol fee on swaps using BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapDelta, distributes fees through an LP locker, and temporarily activates an MEV protection module for the first 2 minutes after pool creation.
